_comment: Authored verifier-evaluation pairs for the Dankjewel Prong 3 MiniCheck PoC (slice 6b, 2026-11-14). These claims are hand-written for this proof of concept and are NOT a public benchmark: 'subject' is the seed-DB entity whose formatted KB facts form the grounding document, and 'expected' is the author's ground truth for how the verifier should relate the claim to that document — 'refuted' (the document contradicts the claim), or 'partial' (only part of the claim is covered by the document: either a supported core plus an unverifiable detail such as a population figure, or one supported fact mixed with one the document does not state). True claims come from data/benchmark_claims.json instead; this file only adds the false/partial half. Scoring thresholds: p >= 0.8 supported, p <= 0.2 refuted, else partial. MiniCheck is a strict entailment model, so supported-plus-unverifiable-detail pairs are expected misses for the 'partial' class — they are kept deliberately to document that behavior.

pairs.claim: Reykjavík is the capital of Denmark.
pairs.subject: Reykjavík

pairs.claim: The Norwegian University of Science and Technology is located in Bergen.
pairs.subject: Norwegian University of Science and Technology

pairs.subject: Oslo

pairs.subject: Helsinki
